provenance_notes: All 72 canonical run manifests are complete: Decode, Prefill, and Balanced across eight global-concurrency points with three repetitions each and zero failed operating points.
The request path was AIPerf through HAProxy leastconn to four independent TP2 vLLM replicas.
Speculative decoding was mandatory; the formal deployment used DSpark with five draft tokens.
The local checkpoint lacks a verified immutable upstream download receipt. The revision is therefore reported as local-unverified and no upstream commit is inferred.
The formal campaign retained the 32K-context profile. An 8K Prefill-only candidate was 0.65% faster in a single qualification run, which was not sufficient to justify reducing context capability.
The campaign path contains local-unveri because the canonical runner truncates revision labels to twelve characters.
Raw campaign artifacts remain authoritative; benchmark outputs do not receive cryptographic checksums.
